layout.adapters: adapters/** and bindings/** are optional source integrations; they are not installed by the base package.

codec_dependency_contracts.name: PAQ v215/v216/joint_discount/store_state
codec_dependency_contracts.source_need: Package the unchanged, versioned source roots and notices selected by the final dependency freeze, or omit the bridge from that build. Do not rely on a workstation-only CIX_PAQ_SOURCE_ROOT.

codec_dependency_contracts.name: libjxl bridge
codec_dependency_contracts.source_need: Package or declare the exact provisioned libjxl 0.12 dependency selected by the final freeze, or omit the bridge. The source bridge is not an installed SDK.

codec_dependency_contracts.name: system codecs
codec_dependency_contracts.source_need: The final package must derive and verify target dependencies for zlib, bzip2, lzma, zstd and Brotli; this skeleton does not claim installed host compatibility.

codec_dependency_contracts.name: vendored source notices
codec_dependency_contracts.source_need: Preserve unchanged vendor source and its upstream/license records whenever it is selected for the build.

non_claims: This allowlist prepares a source-tree export; it does not sign, publish, install or qualify an artifact.
The Python reference/runtime, research evidence, corpora, benchmark outputs and private job material are excluded from the native shipping source tree.
A full-engine RC export remains blocked until the selected PAQ, JXL, system-codec and retained-route closure is accepted. Omitting a bridge is not an RC escape hatch.
Optional adapters and bindings ship as source only. Each requires its declared host SDK and its own compatibility qualification; their presence makes no stock-registry or platform-support claim.
No host adapter, plugin, external registry identifier or platform support is fabricated by this layout.

full-engine-rc.source_members: the validated allowlist member set materialised below cix-{version}
required_capabilities: PAQ v215/v216/joint_discount/store_state source and notices selected by the final freeze
provisioned libjxl 0.12 source/binary dependency selected by the final freeze
all retained route/decoder closure required by RC05
full-engine-rc.rule: The exporter must fail until final-dependency-closure.json declares accepted_full_engine_rc. Omitting PAQ, JXL, retained native bridges, or required decoder dependencies does not make this profile valid.

native-core-optional.source_members: the allowlist member set after an explicitly recorded feature subset is selected
native-core-optional.rule: It may be materialised only under a separately named capability declaration. It cannot satisfy RC05, RC18, RC22, RC44, RC45 or RC51 and must not be labelled a full-engine RC.

engineering-validation.source_members: the same validated allowlist member set materialised below cix-{version}
engineering-validation.rule: This profile permits a scheduled local build/install exercise with an explicit selected-provider manifest. It must write engineering_validation_not_release and must not create, modify, or stand in for final-dependency-closure.json or accepted_full_engine_rc.

workspace_layout.root_build: Makefile generated by the exporter delegates to rust/cix-native
